about: Scene components being built in the lab, before they join a production. Each is ./<id>/scene.js. Kept by c.productions.

scenes.title: Currents before 2001
scenes.beat: A thread of short cycles runs from the 1930s past the 1970 staircase, and five differently behaved streams of the 1990s bend toward a meeting that has not happened yet.

scenes.title: Royce's cascade
scenes.beat: Work pours down a one-way run of steps, the last step breaks, and the flow keeps coming: the 1970 warning as a picture.

scenes.title: Snowbird: seventeen lights, one page
scenes.beat: Seventeen lights cross a night mountain from different directions, gather at a lodge and fuse into one page of four values.

scenes.title: The spread
scenes.beat: The page's light runs outward and hardens, station by station, from something people chose into something institutions require.

scenes.title: The badge factory
scenes.beat: One page is stamped into a city of identical badges, and ends as the smallest thing in view.

scenes.title: Three voices, and the turn
scenes.beat: Three lights leave the crowd in the badge city and speak; the third walks back to the page, and what warms is the people, not the towers.
